states.name: idle
states.action: calm fighting stance idle loop: subtle breathing, small weight shift, fists up, feet planted
requirements: keep the guard stance and facing right in every frame
feet stay planted on the same ground line
first and last frame nearly identical so the loop does not pop

states.name: walk
states.action: side view walk cycle loop of exactly four frames, in place like a treadmill: frame 1 right leg reaches forward with the heel about to touch the ground and the left leg trails behind, frame 2 both legs pass close together as the body rises, frame 3 left leg reaches forward with the heel about to touch the ground and the right leg trails behind, frame 4 both legs pass close together as the body rises
requirements: the legs must be widely split in frames 1 and 3 and close together in frames 2 and 4, so the stride is obvious
the arms hang down and swing relaxed, opposite to the legs, elbows slightly bent, hands open, never fists up at the chest
the torso stays upright with a slight bob: highest in frames 2 and 4, lowest in frames 1 and 3
the body height, head size, hip height and ground line must be identical in all four frames
the character walks in place: it must not travel across the frame, no forward lean
the skirt and hair sway a little behind the motion
frame 4 must flow back into frame 1 as a seamless loop

states.name: crouch
states.action: crouching: knees bent, body lowered to roughly two thirds of standing height, guard in front
requirements: same facing right and same ground line
body clearly and consistently lower than the idle stance
no attack, no jump

states.name: jump
states.action: airborne hover: the character floats off the ground, both legs hanging with knees only slightly bent, arms relaxed slightly out from the body
requirements: only two frames: just leaving the ground, then the airborne hover
keep the body the same height and proportions as the idle pose, do not tuck into a ball or stretch into a leap
feet stay under the body, never kicked out towards the viewer
no ground line, no shadow, no dust

states.name: attack-light
states.action: straight punch with the lead arm: guard, short wind-up, fully extended straight arm at shoulder height, retract
requirements: frame 3 of 4 must show the arm fully extended horizontally at shoulder height
the four frames must be visibly different
no impact effects, no motion lines

states.name: attack-heavy
states.action: heavy overhand punch: big wind-up, full body rotation, arm swung down and forward, recovery
requirements: the striking hand is furthest forward and lowest on frame 3 of 4
the body axis and both feet stay in the same place in every frame
no impact effects, no motion lines, no comic symbols

states.name: kick
states.action: front kick: chamber the knee, extend the leg forward at hip height, retract back to stance
requirements: the kicking foot is furthest forward on frame 3 of 4
the supporting foot stays on the same ground line in every frame
no impact effects, no motion lines

states.name: hurt
states.action: taking a hit: head snapped back, torso leaning away, arms loose, then settling
requirements: same facing right, feet near the same ground line
no blood, no impact sparks, no detached effects

states.name: hurt-air
states.action: hit in mid air: the body arches backwards away from the direction the character faces, head and shoulders thrown back, arms trailing behind, legs swinging forward
requirements: the torso leans backwards, never forwards
the character is clearly airborne, feet off any ground line
keep the same character, palette and outline
no blood, no impact sparks, no detached effects

states.name: attack-air
states.action: airborne upright punch: the character hangs vertically in the air, tall silhouette like the idle pose, feet dangling below the hips, and throws one straight punch upward above the head
requirements: tall vertical silhouette in every frame: head at the top, feet at the bottom, never lying down, never diving, never horizontal
the punching arm extends straight up above the head by frame 3 of 4
the legs hang relaxed below the body, feet never pointed at the camera
clearly airborne with no ground line
no impact effects, no motion lines

states.name: jump-fall
states.action: airborne falling: legs trailing down, arms out for balance, body upright
requirements: clearly airborne, no ground contact
same character, palette and outline

states.name: land
states.action: landing recovery: knees bent absorbing the impact, arms lowered, then starting to rise
requirements: feet planted on the same invisible baseline
no dust, no impact marks, no shadow

states.name: item-hold
states.action: standing guard while holding a small item in one hand at chest height, the other hand still in a loose fist, subtle breathing
requirements: the hand grips a small generic item, keep the grip closed and the arm bent
the same body height, head size and ground line as the idle pose
first and last frame nearly identical so the loop does not pop

states.name: item-swing
states.action: swinging a held item forward: wind up behind the shoulder, arm sweeps through in front of the chest, follow through, recover to guard
requirements: the hand keeps the closed grip on the item the whole time
the striking point is furthest forward on frame 3 of 4
same body height, head size and ground line as the idle pose
no impact effects, no motion lines
